verdict.rationale: Bench documents that customers can download their income statement and balance sheet reports at any time to share with others, which is a limited form of data export. Nothing shows a full-account export or open formats, so this is glancing support only. Missing for 10: a documented export of all data (transactions, receipts, documents, categorizations), stated open file formats (e.g. CSV), an offboarding/account-exit process, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Access or download your updated income statement or balance sheet at all times
Download your reports anytime to share with banks, investors, or anyone else who needs them.
